questions.text: Positive integers have identical HCF and LCM. How are they related?
questions.translation: दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों का HCF और LCM समान है। उनका संबंध?
questions.explanation: HCF ≤ each number ≤ LCM; equality forces both numbers equal.

questions.text: Which fraction has a recurring, non-terminating decimal?
questions.translation: किस भिन्न का दशमलव असांत आवर्ती है?
questions.explanation: A reduced denominator containing a prime other than 2 or 5 prevents termination.

questions.text: A flat reflecting surface has what focal length?
questions.translation: समतल परावर्तक पृष्ठ की फोकस दूरी क्या होगी?
questions.explanation: A plane mirror is the infinite-radius limiting case of a spherical mirror.

questions.text: A mirror forms a real image where reflected rays actually meet. Where is it?
questions.translation: दर्पण की परावर्तित किरणों से वास्तविक प्रतिबिंब कहाँ बनता है?
questions.explanation: Real reflected rays intersect on the reflecting side.

questions.text: Light reflects without changing medium. Its speed becomes:
questions.translation: माध्यम बदले बिना परावर्तन के बाद प्रकाश की चाल:
questions.explanation: Speed depends on the medium, which has not changed.

questions.text: An initially neutral capacitor has plate charges +Q and −Q. Net charge?
questions.translation: आरंभ में उदासीन संधारित्र की पट्टियों पर +Q तथा −Q हैं। कुल आवेश?
questions.explanation: Opposite equal charges sum to zero.

questions.text: What directed electron motion accounts for steady conduction current?
questions.translation: स्थिर चालन धारा के लिए इलेक्ट्रॉनों की कौन-सी निर्देशित गति उत्तरदायी है?
questions.explanation: A small net drift is superimposed on random thermal motion.

questions.text: Series capacitors 2 μF and 4 μF share 1200 V. Voltage on 2 μF?
questions.translation: श्रेणी में 2 μF तथा 4 μF पर कुल 1200 V है। 2 μF पर विभव?
questions.explanation: Equal charge gives V₂/V₄ = 4/2; the smaller capacitor receives 800 V.

questions.text: Which settlement is associated with an excavated Harappan ploughed field?
questions.translation: खुदाई में मिले हड़प्पाई जुते खेत का संबंध किस स्थल से है?
questions.explanation: Kalibangan provides archaeological evidence of a ploughed field.

questions.text: Which material commonly appears in Harappan stamp seals?
questions.translation: हड़प्पाई मुहरों में सामान्यतः कौन-सा पदार्थ मिलता है?
questions.explanation: Steatite was commonly carved into seals.

questions.text: The archaeological city of Harappa lies beside which river?
questions.translation: पुरातात्त्विक हड़प्पा नगर किस नदी के समीप है?
questions.explanation: Harappa is associated with the Ravi river.

questions.text: In traditional classification, a receipts-and-payments summary represents which account type?
questions.translation: परंपरागत वर्गीकरण में प्राप्ति-भुगतान सारांश किस प्रकार का खाता है?
questions.explanation: It summarises cash/bank transactions and is a real account.

questions.text: Uncollected membership subscription due to a club is classified as:
questions.translation: क्लब को मिलने वाला बकाया सदस्यता शुल्क क्या है?
questions.explanation: An amount receivable is an asset.

questions.text: Which traditional account category covers the realisation account?
questions.translation: वसूली खाते का परंपरागत वर्गीकरण क्या है?
questions.explanation: It records realisation gains and losses, hence is nominal.
